grammar_focus: 现在完成被动(have/has been done:cities have been raised / it has not been planned)、so that … may …(目的)+ as … as possible、过去分词作定语(life imposed by the factory / streets choked with fumes)、where 引导的定语从句(towers where people are packed)、While 引导的让步 + that 宾语从句(NCE4 无 KS 页,考点由课文结构自取;IP:源为阿列克西·卡雷尔《人之奥秘》论著,已用 100% 原创行文复述‘现代城市为逐利而建、不顾居民身心’的批判,无人物、无逐句改写;题材=城市与工业化反思·无害;美语化 gasoline/truck/apartment;第四册第16课)
scene: 当我们组织工业生活时,几乎完全忘了工厂对在其中劳作的男男女女的身体与心灵所起的作用。现代工业建立在一个念头之上:以尽可能低的成本换取尽可能大的产量,好让一家公司或一个人尽量多赚钱。它一路膨胀,却全然不顾照看机器的那些人究竟是怎样的存在,也丝毫不曾考虑工厂强加的那种人为生活,会给这些工人及其后代带来什么。我们的大城市几乎毫不顾及我们便拔地而起。一座摩天大楼的高度与尺寸,完全由这样的心思决定:从每一平方英尺土地上榨出最大的租金,并给租户提供能吸引他们的那种办公室与公寓。就这样,一座座庞大而狰狞的高塔被竖了起来,塔里塞进了太多太多的人。文明人似乎很喜欢这样一种生活方式。他们一边享受着房间里的舒适与廉价的奢华,一边却从没察觉,自己已被剥夺了生活真正的必需品。归根结底,现代城市不过是一堆巨大的楼房和阴暗狭窄的街道,被无数引擎的毒气所窒塞,被汽车和公交没完没了的轰鸣所震动,从早到晚被躁动的人群挤满。显然,它并不是为住在其中的人的福祉而规划的。

grammar_card.title: 现在完成被动 / so that 目的 / 过去分词作定语 / where 定语从句 / While 让步
grammar_card.intro: ①现在完成被动 have/has + been + 过去分词:cities have been raised;it has not been planned。②so that … may …(目的);as … as possible。③过去分词作定语:the life imposed by the factory;streets choked with fumes。④where 引导定语从句(先行词是地点):towers where people are packed。⑤While(虽然)引导让步;realize that …(宾语从句)。

rows: so that a person may make money
the life imposed by the factory
While they enjoy it, they miss much

specialRules.rule: 现在完成被动=have/has + been + 过去分词,主语单数用 has been,复数用 have been。
where 引导定语从句时先行词是表地点的名词(place, city, tower…),在从句中作状语。
美式拼写/用词:gasoline(汽油,英式 petrol)、truck(卡车,英式 lorry)、apartment(公寓,英式 flat)。本课已按美语写。

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — What is the author's main argument about the modern city?
options: It is built for profit, with no regard for the good of its inhabitants
It is the healthiest place to live
It was carefully planned around nature
It has too few tall buildings

passage: When we organize our industrial life, we almost entirely forget the effect that the factory has on the body and mind of the men and women who work in it. Modern industry rests on a single idea: the greatest possible output at the lowest possible cost, so that a company or a person may make as much money as it can. It has grown without any real thought for the human beings who tend the machines, and without the slightest consideration for what the artificial life imposed by the factory does to those workers and to their descendants. Our great cities have been raised with almost no regard for us. The height and dimensions of a skyscraper are decided entirely by the wish to squeeze the maximum rent out of every square foot of ground, and to offer tenants the kind of offices and apartments that will attract them. In this way enormous, monstrous towers have been thrown up, towers where far too many people are packed together. Civilized men seem to enjoy such a way of living. While they take pleasure in the comfort and the cheap luxury of their rooms, they never notice that they have been deprived of the true necessities of life. The modern city, in the end, is little more than a mass of huge buildings and dark, narrow streets, choked with the toxic fumes of countless engines, shaken by the endless roar of cars and buses, and thronged from morning to night by restless crowds. Plainly, it has not been planned for the good of the people who must live in it.

grammar_points.name: 现在完成被动(have/has been done)
so that … may …(目的)+ as … as possible
where 引导的定语从句(towers where…)
While 让步 + that 宾语从句

stage5.stem: "The great cities ___ been raised with no regard for us."(现在完成被动 ___ + been + 过去分词,填第一个助动词)
stage5.stem_cn: 那些大城市的建造根本不顾我们。

stage5.stem: "The city has not ___ planned for its people."(现在完成被动 has not + ___ + 过去分词,填中间的词)
stage5.stem_cn: 这座城市的规划并不为它的居民着想。

stage5.stem: "Workers have been ___ of the necessities of life."(现在完成被动 have been + 过去分词;deprive 的过去分词)
stage5.stem_cn: 工人被剥夺了生活的必需品。

stage5.stem: "Factories cut costs so ___ owners may earn more."(‘以便、为了’的目的连词 so ___,填第二个词)
stage5.stem_cn: 工厂压低成本,以便老板多赚。

stage5.stem: "They aim at the ___ output at the lowest cost."(‘最大的’,填形容词)
stage5.stem_cn: 他们追求成本最低下的最大产量。

stage5.stem: "Each person wants to earn as much money as ___."(as much … as ___:‘尽可能多’,填这个词)
stage5.stem_cn: 每个人都想尽可能多赚钱。

stage5.stem: "The artificial life ___ by the factory harms the workers."(过去分词作定语,‘被强加的’;impose 的过去分词)
stage5.stem_cn: 工厂强加的人为生活损害着工人。

stage5.stem: "Streets ___ with toxic fumes fill the modern city."(过去分词作定语,‘被…堵塞的’;choke 的过去分词)
stage5.stem_cn: 被毒气堵塞的街道充斥着现代城市。

stage5.stem: "The effects ___ on their descendants are ignored."(过去分词作定语,‘施加于…的’;produce 的过去分词)
stage5.stem_cn: 对其后代造成的影响被忽视了。

stage5.stem: "They build towers ___ too many people are packed together."(定语从句,指地点,填关系副词)
stage5.stem_cn: 他们盖起挤满太多人的高楼。

stage5.stem: "The factory is a place ___ workers lose their health."(定语从句,指地点,填关系副词)
stage5.stem_cn: 工厂是工人失去健康的地方。

stage5.stem: "This is a city ___ nobody thinks of the inhabitants."(定语从句,指地点,填关系副词)
stage5.stem_cn: 这是一座没人想着居民的城市。

stage5.stem: "___ they enjoy the luxury, they miss the real necessities."(‘虽然、尽管’,填连词)
stage5.stem_cn: 虽然他们享受着奢华,却错失了真正的必需品。

stage5.stem: "They do not realize ___ they have been deprived of much."(宾语从句,‘…这件事’,填连词)
stage5.stem_cn: 他们没意识到自己已被剥夺了许多。

stage5.stem: "___ the city looks grand, it is not built for people."(‘尽管’,填让步连词)
stage5.stem_cn: 尽管这城市看着宏伟,却不是为人而建。

stage5.stem: "A very tall city building of many floors is a ___."(“摩天大楼”用哪个词)
stage5.stem_cn: 一座许多层的高高的城市大楼。

stage5.stem: "A person who rents and lives in a place is a ___."(“租户、房客”用哪个词)
"Poisonous and harmful to living things means ___."(“有毒的”用哪个词)
